## Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
data(storms)
storms <- storms[!is.na(storms$category),] # Only analyze hurricanes
year   <- storms$year
name   <- paste0(storms$name,"_",storms$year)
wind   <- storms$wind
uni    <- unique(name)
```

## Given Code

```{r}
# Compute the maximum wind speed by storm
n          <- length(uni)
year_storm <- rep(0,n)
mxspd      <- rep(0,n)
for(i in 1:length(uni)){
  year_storm[i] <- min(year[name==uni[i]])
  mxspd[i]      <- max(wind[name==uni[i]])
} 

```



```{r}
# Compute the number of storms per year
 
year <- as.numeric(names(table(year_storm)))
cnt  <- as.vector(table(year_storm))

plot(year_storm,mxspd,xlab="Year",ylab="Max wind speed (knots)")
plot(year,cnt,xlab="Year",ylab="Number of hurricanes")
```

##Further Data Manipulations

```{r}
# Dividing the Datasets based on year. Period 1 is 1975-1999, Period 2 is 2000-2021
period1 <- year[!is.na(year)]
period1 <- year[year >= 1975 & year <= 1999]
period1_storm <-year_storm[!is.na(year_storm) & year_storm >= 1975 & year_storm <= 1999]

period2 <- year[!is.na(year)]
period2 <- year[year >= 2000 & year <= 2021]
period2_storm <-year_storm[!is.na(year_storm) & year_storm >= 2000 & year_storm <= 2021]

# Speed
# log of spd to make domain neg infinity to pos
# Centering wind speed at 0 so -65 as that was the min speed

speedperiod1 <- log(mxspd[1:143]) - log(65)
speedperiod2 <- log(mxspd[143:310]) - log(65)


```



## Wind Speed Analysis

```{r}
S <- 10000

normal_Gibbs <- function(Y, n.iters = 30000,
 m=0.1, a=0.1, b=0.1){ # define the priors
 n <- length(Y)
 # Initial values
 mu <- mean(Y)
 s2 <- var(Y)
 keep.mu <- rep(0,n.iters)
 keep.sigma <- rep(0,n.iters)
 keep.mu[1] <- mu
 keep.sigma[1] <- sqrt(s2)
 for(iter in 2:n.iters){
 # sample mu|s2,Y
 MN <- sum(Y)/(n+m)
 VR <- s2/(n+m)
 mu <- rnorm(1,MN,sqrt(VR))
 # sample s2|mu,Y
 A <- a + n/2
 B <- b + sum((Y-mu)^2)/2
 s2 <- 1/rgamma(1,A,B)
 # keep track of the results
 keep.mu[iter] <- mu
 keep.sigma[iter] <- sqrt(s2)
 }
out <- list(mu=keep.mu,sigma=keep.sigma)
return(out)}

set.seed(111)

spd1 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod1)
spd2 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod2)

plot(spd1$mu,type="l")
plot(spd1$sigma,type="l")

plot(spd2$mu,type="l")
plot(spd2$sigma,type="l")


```
## Speed comparison and interval

```{r}
t.test(spd1$mu,spd2$mu, alternative = "less")
```




## Hurricane Count Analysis

```{r}
lambda <- seq(0.1,10,length=100)
a <- 0.1
b <- 0.1
yCountperiod1 <- length(period1_storm)
yCountperiod2 <- length(period2_storm)


Nperiod1 <- 25
Nperiod2 <- 22

#Plots period1 and adds period2 as a line
 plot(lambda, dgamma(lambda, yCountperiod1 + a, Nperiod1 + b), type = "l", col = "blue",
      xlab = expression(lambda), ylab = "Posterior Distribution")
 lines(lambda, dgamma(lambda, yCountperiod2 + a, Nperiod2 + b), col = "red")
legend("topleft",c("1975-1999","2000-2021"),lwd=2,col=c("blue","red"))


# MC sampling to compare means
 set.seed(111)
lambda_p1 <- rgamma(S,yCountperiod1 + a, Nperiod1 + b)
lambda_p2 <- rgamma(S,yCountperiod2 + a, Nperiod2 + b)
mean(lambda_p1)
mean(lambda_p2)

mean(lambda_p1<lambda_p2)

```
## Uncertainty

```{r}
summary(spd2$mu - spd1$mu)
summary(lambda_p2 - lambda_p1)

qlowcountp1 <- qgamma(0.025,yCountperiod1 + a, Nperiod1 + b)
qhighcountp1 <- qgamma(0.975,yCountperiod1 + a, Nperiod1 + b)
qlowcountp2 <- qgamma(0.025,yCountperiod2 + a, Nperiod2 + b)
qhighcountp2 <- qgamma(0.975,yCountperiod2 + a, Nperiod2 + b)
qtable <- round(matrix(c(qlowcountp1,qlowcountp2,qhighcountp1,qhighcountp2), nrow=2),2)
rownames(qtable)<- c("Period 1","Period 2")
colnames(qtable) <- c("lowerQuantile","upperQuantile")
qtable
```

## Table
```{r}
meanC <- mean(lambda_p2 - lambda_p1)
sdC <- sd(lambda_p2 - lambda_p1)
meanS <- mean(spd2$mu - spd1$mu)
sdS <- sd(spd2$sigma - spd1$sigma)
stormtab <- matrix(c(meanC,meanS,sdC,sdS), ncol=2)
rownames(stormtab)<- c("Count","Speed")
colnames(stormtab) <- c("Mean","SD")
stormtab
```


## Sensitivity For Speed

``` {r}
spd1test1 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod1,m=1, a=1, b=1)
spd2test1 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod2,m=1, a=1, b=1)

plot(spd1test1$mu,type="l")
plot(spd1test1$sigma,type="l")

plot(spd2test1$mu,type="l")
plot(spd2test1$sigma,type="l")
```

## Sensitivity For Speed

``` {r}
spd1test2 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod1,m=0.01, a=0.01, b=0.01)
spd2test2 <- normal_Gibbs(speedperiod2,m=0.01, a=0.01, b=0.01)

plot(spd1test2$mu,type="l")
plot(spd1test2$sigma,type="l")

plot(spd2test2$mu,type="l")
plot(spd2test2$sigma,type="l")
```
